title: Aurora: A Child's Journey
summary: Owned the Act II player experience, designing and refining 3C mechanics and puzzle layouts. Partnered with Level Design to iterate on pacing via playtest feedback, leading sessions that shaped the final game.
highlights: Games for Change Latin America 2020 — Winner
Co-defined the 3C: camera, character and control
Owned Act II gameplay and puzzle design end-to-end

title: Wardens Rising
summary: Drove combat and systems design at the core of the game. Balanced high-density wave combat using playtest telemetry, authored 30+ progression assets and economy features, and co-directed boss encounters alongside multidisciplinary teams.
highlights: Built TTK/DPS models in Sheets, then ported them into Unreal Data Assets
Designed the behaviour trees for 4 major boss encounters
Architected an AI targeting-cap and aggro-cooldown system to restore combat readability
Shaped horde spawning and the difficulty curve from telemetry heatmaps

title: FC 27: Streamlined SBCs
summary: When cards become points, the points table becomes the economy. This teardown traces two jumps in FC 27’s Item Score curve that make one rating the only sensible fodder. It proposes an even 28% step, plus a live-event test before any permanent change.

title: Overwatch: Ranked Systems
summary: Overwatch’s matchmaker builds fair games, but the rank players see is what breaks. This redesign replaces resets with season check-ins and halves matches played at the wrong rank across 300 modelled players.

title: Gundam: Requiem for Vengeance
summary: Designed and pitched the mode for an external IP partner, turning a UEFN limit on vehicle control into the competitive hook: teams contest objectives to earn the mech, then choose which part of the map it reshapes.

title: Plushland Curse
summary: Owned combat, enemy AI and the weapon system on a toy-themed souls-like: 15 enemy archetypes against a six-rule design standard, and a rock-paper-scissors damage matrix balanced from a hit-to-kill model.

title: Far Away from Orbital Space
summary: Built the scoring algorithms, puzzle gating and progression for a co-op communication puzzler, validating every system on paper and in Miro before it reached the engine.

title: Ascending Flags
genre: Card Game | Design Lead & Project Manager
summary: Led design, art and engineering on a 17-person team. Built a single mana pool where moving, attacking and defending compete every turn, plus a 40+ card catalog balanced with Machinations.

title: Crafting Economy
summary: A three-tier RPG crafting economy that broke when tested against casual, average and hardcore players over 100 hours. Rebuilt so nothing hoards or runs dry, and so crafting asks real questions: roll or target, gamble or ward.
